<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex88052023-10-043" status="unreviewed">   <milestone unit="section" n="Conclusive verses (20b8–21a1)"/>
               <lg>  <l> <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3770">mdo</rs> dang <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3772">rnam 'grel</rs> las sogs rigs gzhung du ma dang || </l>
           <l> myong pa'i stobs dang rtags stobs las 'ongs rigs pa rnams ||</l> <l><lb n="21a1"/> rtogs ngan dug chu'i dri mas ma sbags don gyi snying po blangs ||</l> <l>gzu' bo'i blo yis don dang don min rnam bshad byas || </l></lg>
           <note type="translation"> I have obtained the essence of meaning – the reasoning coming from the force of experience and evidence and (from?) the many logical works such as PS and PV - unstained by the poison-water of bad conceptions.
(I) have explained what is the meaning and what is not the meaning with a honest mind
</note>
           <lg><l>bsod nams 'di yis 'gro ba ma lus pa ||</l>  <l>kun mkhyen rgyal po myur du thob par shog ||</l></lg> <note type="translation">Owing to these merits, may all beings quickly obtain (the status) of king of omniscients!</note></seg></TEI>
